cover.title: Tiny Theme Studio
cover.quote: But if I'm not the same, the next question is, Who in the world am I?\nAh, THAT'S the great Enigma! ➰

rabbit-hole.title: DOWN SCOPE CREEP HOLE
rabbit-hole.quote: Down, down, down... Would the fall never come to an end?\nI wonder how deeper I've fallen by this time.

angular.title: THE ENTRY-POINT CAT
angular.quote: — Would you tell me, please, which way I should go to get in?\n— That depends a good deal on where you want to get to.\n— I don't much care where...

html.title: THE QUEEN'S SEMANTIC
html.quote: — And the moral of that is:\nTake care of the semantics and the sense will take care of itself.

css.title: THE LAND OF VARIABLES
css.quote: — We're all mad here. I'm mad. You're mad.\n— How do you know I'm mad?\n— You must be, or you wouldn't have come here.

journey.title: THE JOURNEY
journey.quote: If you knew Time as well as I do, you wouldn't talk about wasting it. It's him
journey.text: Like Alice following the rabbit, this project is a journey through a world of decisions and surprises.\nI found a small golden key and opened the door without knowing what lay beyond.\nIt doesn't follow rigid conventions or pretend to be an example of anything: it's a rabbit hole to get lost in.

conclusion.title: Sarah's Declaration
conclusion.text: I drank the CSS potion and sad RGBs split into beams of Light to play with.\nEverything was tinged with Saturation and Hues, and the shadows cast beautifully down below.
